caveats: Operational completion and returned counts do not certify factual correctness, useful teaching, difficulty or learning.

Role-specific runtime JSON parseability is a format observation; parseable responses can still violate solver or review schema. The more permissive author parser can extract arrays from some strict-role-invalid responses; those diagnostic extractions are not valid solver/reviewer records.
Raw author array counts are occurrences across normal attempts, not deduplicated questions or validated candidates.
Call-budget exhaustion at four calls means fewer than the three slots needed to admit another fully verified pass; it does not imply all six slots were spent.

Per-operation elapsed time through the last observer is reconstructed from millisecond admission samples and observed process intervals; it excludes final persistence and is not exact total trial wall time.
The capture retains raw final text and sanitized usage/lifecycle metadata; reasoning bodies, headers, and complete provider wire responses are intentionally not retained.
Worker transcript byte counts are reconstructed from the four frozen message schemas and final recorded values; original socket bytes are not separately archived.
raw_parse_method: Author roles use frozen question_quality._extract_json_object; solver/reviewer/teaching-auditor roles use their actual frozen _strict_json_object front end. These counts do not assert later role-schema validity. Diagnostic author-parser extraction is recorded separately and never substitutes for strict role parsing.
